cards.title: Women should not have to travel for hours to give birth
cards.body: Hospital closures are putting pregnant women's lives at risk across the UK. Readers reflect on the urgent need for accessible maternity services in remote areas.

cards.title: How surrogacy helped my sister and friends
cards.body: A reader shares her family's positive experience with surrogacy as an alternative path to parenthood. The piece responds to ongoing debates about surrogacy regulation and ethics.

cards.title: I've forgotten so much about my second baby
cards.body: A parent reflects on how much she's forgotten between her first and second child, from feeding routines to developmental milestones. Her mother's practical support has been invaluable while also stirring memories of her own childhood.

cards.title: Parenting is hard. Should we let AI do it?
cards.body: Tech companies are offering eye-movement trackers and personalized parenting podcasts to optimize child development. The article questions whether parents actually need these tools or if they add unnecessary complexity.

cards.title: Should I try the '18 summers' parenting trend?
cards.body: The viral '18 summers' trend encourages parents to maximize quality time with their children before they leave home. Critics argue it transforms carefree summer breaks into pressure-filled 'memory-making' exercises.

cards.title: Your child's anxiety has a daily schedule
cards.body: Your child's anxiety may appear random but often follows a predictable daily pattern. Identifying these schedules can help parents better support their anxious children.

cards.title: Are you launching a college freshman?
cards.body: Parents can embrace the milestone transition between high school and college with practical strategies and emotional support. This guide helps families navigate the significant changes ahead.

cards.title: Parents pushed to breaking point by Child Maintenance Service
cards.body: Both mothers and fathers describe struggles with the Child Maintenance Service, from difficulty collecting payments to wrongful overcharges. The system is pushing separated parents to their limits.
